title: Atlas Launcher 1.8.1
summary: Fixes the Windows restart after a launcher update.

sections.title: Updates
items: Fixed a Windows access-denied error that prevented the launcher from restarting after installation and caused an automatic rollback to the previous version.
The launcher restarts with your own user account, without administrator rights.
Update logs now retain the Windows error code to help diagnose failures.

sections.title: If your update is stuck
items: Fully close Atlas Launcher, then run the 1.8.1 installer over your existing installation. Your settings are preserved.
This one-time installation replaces the faulty updater in the previously installed version.
